# appleads_keyword_report (Data Source)

Reads Apple Ads keyword-level performance within an ad group.

Read-only snapshot from `POST /api/v5/reports/campaigns/{campaignId}/adgroups/{adgroupId}/keywords`. For Apple suggested CPT, use `appleads_keyword_bid_recommendations` instead of copying report bids into configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_keyword_report" "generic" {
  campaign_id = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id = "9876543210"
  start_time  = "2026-09-01"
  end_time    = "2026-09-14"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ad_group_id` (String) Parent ad group id.
- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign id.
- `end_time` (String) Report end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `start_time` (String) Report start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

### Optional

- `time_zone` (String) Report time zone. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `campaign_id/ad_group_id/start_time/end_time`.
- `keywords` (Attributes List) Keyword rows for the window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keywords))

<a id="nestedatt--keywords"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keywords`

Read-Only:

- `avg_cpa_amount` (String) Average CPA / CPI as a decimal string (`totalAvgCPI`).
- `avg_cpa_currency` (String) Average CPA currency.
- `avg_cpt_amount` (String) Average CPT as a decimal string.
- `avg_cpt_currency` (String) Average CPT currency.
- `conversion_rate` (Number) Conversion rate.
- `impressions` (Number) Impressions in the report window.
- `installs` (Number) Total installs (tap + view) in the report window.
- `keyword_id` (String) Keyword id.
- `local_spend_amount` (String) Spend as a decimal string.
- `local_spend_currency` (String) Spend currency.
- `match_type` (String) EXACT or BROAD.
- `taps` (Number) Taps in the report window.
- `text` (String) Keyword text.
- `ttr` (Number) Tap-through rate.
